    Welcome to S.D. Government College, Beawar
    Accredited with a prestigious NAAC Grade “B”, S.D. Government College, Beawar stands as a beacon of academic excellence and heritage. Nestled in a serene environment, the college is conveniently located just 3 kilometers from the Beawar Bus Stand and 2 kilometers from the Railway Station, ensuring easy accessibility for students and visitors alike.
    Established in the year 1904, the institution carries a rich legacy of over a century in the field of education. HISTORY

1592:

Beawar is a city in Rajasthan, India. Beawar was the capital of Merwara (मेरवाड़ा) state of Rajputana. As of 2016, the population of Beawar is 3,25,000. It is located 184 kilometres (114 mi) southwest of the state capital Jaipur, amidst Aravali hills. The city used to be a major center of trade, especially in raw cotton, and used to have cotton mills. Other industries include food processing, mineral based units, machine based units, machine tools and accessories, pre-stressed concrete pipes, plastic products, textiles, wooden furniture and asbestos cement pipes. Beawar is the largest producer of cement in northern India and home to Shree Cement. It lies in mineral rich region having reserves of feldspar, quartz, asbestos, soapstone, magnesite, calcite, limestone, mica, emerald, granite, and masonry stone. Fairly good reserves of barytes, fluorite, wollastonite and vermiculite have also been found. The nearest airport is in Jaipur, at a distance of 190 km.

1561:

Principal Message

1586:

Principal Message

1587:

Dear Students,

                 I welcome you all in this prestigious institution, in beautiful Campus of S.D. Govt. College, which is situated amidst the arbour of trees. Beawar (Ajmer) has been a place of historical and religious importance where Jagat Guru Shankracharya and Swami Kumaranand lived.

                 Awarded A grade by NAAC, this college provides education in the faculties of Science, Arts and Commerce in the best possible ways.                 The College has been imparting education to the students from rural areas for the last 60 years, & the students who have studied here, have proved themselves in turn at various levels in service of their country and motherland. I would like to convince the new comers that they will find here teachers who will guide them in an amiable atmosphere. All your dreams and aspirations will be fulfilled by getting education in the serene and peaceful environment of this great institution. I would like you to take care of the lush green campus of this enchanting college. The college is yours and it’s your duty to take care of its belongings. Library is the heart of every teaching institution and the library of this college has more than a hundred thousand books to offer. I would like you to use this vast collection of great books in your spare time as you all very well know that books are our best friends.     N.C.C.,N.S.S. and Rovers and several other extra-curricular activities help students of this college in their overall development I promise you that time spent in this college in the persuasion of knowledge will be the best time of your life enabling you to acquire mental, psychological and emotional maturity. Life is full of challenges and here you will learn how to meet these challenges. I wish you very best for your future life.

 

Dr. Sushil Kumar Bissu

Principal, S. D. Government College, Beawar

EMAIL ID : susilkbissu@gmail.com

MOBILE : 9414840898

Welcome to S.D. Government College, Beawar
Accredited with a prestigious NAAC Grade “B”, S.D. Government College, Beawar stands as a beacon of academic excellence and heritage. Nestled in a serene environment, the college is conveniently located just 3 kilometers from the Beawar Bus Stand and 2 kilometers from the Railway Station, ensuring easy accessibility for students and visitors alike.
Established in the year 1904, the institution carries a rich legacy of over a century in the field of education. It was later taken over by the Government of Rajasthan in 1955, marking a new era of growth and development. Today, the college is proudly affiliated with Maharshi Dayanand Saraswati University, Ajmer, maintaining high academic standards and a commitment to holistic education.
The college offers a diverse range of undergraduate and postgraduate programs across the Arts, Science, and Commerce streams, fostering intellectual growth, critical thinking, and professional competence among its students.
With its blend of tradition and modernity, S.D. Government College continues to shape futures, inspire minds, and uphold the values of quality education.

Beawar is a city in Rajasthan, India. Beawar was the capital of Merwara (मेरवाड़ा) state of Rajputana. As of 2016, the population of Beawar is 3,25,000. It is located 184 kilometres (114 mi) southwest of the state capital Jaipur, amidst Aravali hills. The city used to be a major center of trade, especially in raw cotton, and used to have cotton mills. Other industries include food processing, mineral based units, machine based units, machine tools and accessories, pre-stressed concrete pipes, plastic products, textiles, wooden furniture and asbestos cement pipes. Beawar is the largest producer of cement in northern India and home to Shree Cement. It lies in mineral rich region having reserves of feldspar, quartz, asbestos, soapstone, magnesite, calcite, limestone, mica, emerald, granite, and masonry stone. Fairly good reserves of barytes, fluorite, wollastonite and vermiculite have also been found. The nearest airport is in Jaipur, at a distance of 190 km.
